infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SHIELD uses your location to plan safer routes, share your walk with guardians and send it with an SOS.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SHIELD listens for a sustained scream so it can start an SOS for you. Audio is analysed on your phone and is not stored unless an SOS starts.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: SHIELD can start an SOS when you shake your phone, if you turn that on.
